content: Case Studies. Second, we present several case studies in order to study the differences between our baseline and the worker adversarial models. We conduct a closed test on the training set, the results of which can be regarded as modifications of the training corpus, since there exist inconsistent annotations for each training sentence among the different workers. Figure 3 shows the two examples from the DL-PS dataset, which compares the outputs of the baseline and our final models, as well as the majority-voting strategy.
